description: Omit model or use rules for the existing yes_no, choice and scale rule engine with probability, confidence and action. Use model clef for noul, choice and score questions with instructions and criteria. Model mode processes the submitted state and questions and returns structured answers without an automatic action or rule trace. Model requests allow up to 8 KiB of JSON, 4 questions and 8 choices per question, and have their own usage limit of 60 per minute and 1000 per UTC day per IP. Refusals may carry Retry-After. Do not retry automatically. state holds the facts. For rules, each rule is {"if": condition, "weight": number}, where a condition tests a field of state with eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, in, exists, prefix or contains, combined with any and not. Request and answer bodies are not stored by this API. Usage counters are stored. Do not send credentials or sensitive personal data. The full format is at https://aisense.no/free-public-api-decide-api-endpoint. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.

model.description: Optional. rules (default), or a configured model such as clef. Unknown models are refused.

questions.description: 1 to 64 named rule questions, or up to 4 model questions under the default model limits.

state.description: The facts the rules test, or the input sent to the selected model.

name: decide
title: Decide from rules or a model
